pages.title: Superman Standing with His Hands on His Hips and His Cape Flowing Behind Him Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman standing with his hands on his hips, smiling beneath his curled forelock as his cape spreads behind his shoulders. The large S shield, belt, and tall boots define his costume. Simple clouds leave broad open sections around the full figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Flying Above the Metropolis Skyline and the Daily Planet Globe Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman flies above the Metropolis skyline in this printable coloring page, extending one fist as his cape curves over the Daily Planet globe and tall buildings. His bent knee adds movement to the diagonal pose. The coloring sheet combines broad costume sections with small windows and the globe's crossing lines.

pages.title: Superman S Shield Logo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page centers Superman's S shield logo on a close portrait, with his smiling face, curled hair, and cape collar above the diamond emblem. Thick contours divide the large shield and chest areas. The coloring sheet keeps the background blank, emphasizing the emblem, facial features, and simple shoulder folds.

pages.title: Clark Kent Opening His Shirt to Reveal the Superman Emblem Beneath His Reporter Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: Clark Kent opens his shirt to reveal the Superman emblem in this printable coloring page, gripping both sides beneath his glasses, suit jacket, and loosened tie. A small skyline sits behind his reporter outfit. Broad jacket panels contrast with shirt buttons, knuckles, and the curved S design on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Clark Kent Writing a Newspaper Story at His Daily Planet Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Clark Kent writing a newspaper story at his Daily Planet desk, with glasses, a typewriter, and stacks of paper in view. The Daily Planet globe appears through the tall window behind him. A desk lamp, pencil cup, and mug add smaller office details around the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Posing Beside the Daily Planet Globe While Jimmy Olsen Takes His Photograph Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman poses beside the Daily Planet globe in this printable coloring page while Jimmy Olsen aims a camera at him from across the rooftop. Superman rests both hands at his hips beneath the large lettered globe. The coloring sheet includes Jimmy's bow tie, the camera lens, and simple skyline outlines.

pages.title: Superman Being Interviewed By Lois Lane Outside the Daily Planet Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lois Lane interviewing Superman outside the Daily Planet, holding a microphone toward his chest while carrying a spiral notebook and pen. Superman stands beside the building entrance with one hand at his waist. Clothing folds, the globe above, and notebook rings provide smaller coloring details.

pages.title: Superman Carrying Lois Lane Safely Above the Streets of Metropolis Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman carries Lois Lane above Metropolis in this printable coloring page, supporting her in both arms while his cape flows beside the clouds and distant buildings. Lois rests an arm over his shoulder. The coloring sheet combines broad cape and costume sections with her jacket, shoes, and small skyline windows.

pages.title: Superman and Krypto Flying Together Above the Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman and Krypto flying together above the clouds, with Superman's fist extended and the dog's ears and cape streaming backward. Krypto wears a collar with an S shield tag. Rounded clouds and small motion marks frame the pair's large costume and fur sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman in His 2025 Movie Suit Sitting Beside Krypto on the Moon with Earth Above the Horizon Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman sits beside Krypto on the moon in his 2025 movie suit in this printable coloring page, with a large Earth rising beyond the cratered horizon. Both capes rest behind the seated figures as they face each other. Rocks, stars, and crater rims add smaller shapes around the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman and Supergirl Flying Side By Side Toward a Distant Planet Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman and Supergirl flying side by side toward a distant planet, with their capes billowing and Supergirl's long hair trailing behind. A ringed planet and scattered stars complete the space scene. Large costume sections surround smaller S emblems, hair strands, and skirt folds on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Teaching Young Jon Kent as Superboy to Lift a Boulder at the Kent Farm Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman teaches young Jon Kent to lift a boulder at the Kent farm in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside the child's hands on the rounded rock. Both wear S emblems and capes near a wooden fence. A barn, silo, and grass tufts add smaller farm details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman and Batman Watching Over the City From a Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman and Batman watching the city from a rooftop, sitting together on a brick ledge with their boots hanging over the edge. Stars and tall buildings rise behind their capes. The coloring sheet includes broad costume areas, distinct chest emblems, and smaller brick and window shapes.

pages.title: Superman Facing Batman in His Armored Battle Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman faces Batman in an armored battle suit in this printable coloring page, with both heroes clenching their fists against a sparse city and rubble background. Batman's segmented helmet and large shoulder plates contrast with Superman's smooth costume. Utility pouches, armor joints, and chest emblems add detailed sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman and Wonder Woman Defending Civilians From Attacking Parademons Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman and Wonder Woman defending civilians from attacking Parademons, with Superman airborne and Wonder Woman holding a shield before a crouching family. Winged attackers surround the heroes above broken pavement. The coloring sheet combines broad capes and wings with armor, lasso coils, and worried facial expressions.

pages.title: Superman Standing with Batman, Wonder Woman, and the Flash Outside the Hall of Justice Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman stands with Batman, Wonder Woman, and the Flash outside the Hall of Justice in this printable coloring page, with the building's wide arch behind them. Each hero wears a distinct chest emblem and costume. Steps, tall columns, utility pouches, and Wonder Woman's lasso add smaller details to the group coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Racing the Flash Along an Open Country Road Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman racing the Flash along an open country road, with both heroes running toward the foreground beside the dashed center line. Superman's cape streams backward as dust and motion marks trail their feet. Low hills, bushes, and clouds surround broad road sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Lego Superman Standing Outside a Brick-built Daily Planet Building Coloring Page
pages.description: Lego Superman stands outside a brick-built Daily Planet in this printable coloring page, with curved hands, block-shaped legs, and a cape beneath the studded rooftop globe. Windows and rows of bricks fill the building behind him. The coloring sheet adds a small hydrant, streetlamp, and circular studs around the broad minifigure shapes.

pages.title: Chibi Superman Rescuing a Kitten From a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows chibi Superman rescuing a kitten from a tree, floating beside the branch with his hands open beneath a large curled forelock. The kitten perches among small leaves near the trunk. Broad head and cape sections contrast with fur tufts, leaf veins, and bark lines on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Baby Superman as Kal El Resting in His Open Kryptonian Spacecraft Beside Martha and Jonathan Kent Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Superman rests in an open Kryptonian spacecraft beside Martha and Jonathan Kent in this printable coloring page, raising his hands from the padded interior at their farm. Jonathan wears overalls and a hat while Martha kneels in an apron. The coloring sheet includes spacecraft panels, a windmill, and a distant barn.

pages.title: Young Clark Kent Lifting a Tractor at the Kent Farm Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Clark Kent lifts a tractor above his head at the Kent farm in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath its large treaded wheels and engine. His open shirt reveals an S emblem above cuffed jeans and boots. A barn, silo, and fence add smaller farm details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Lifting a Car Above His Head on a Metropolis Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman lifting a car above his head on a Metropolis street, supporting the chassis with both hands beneath its round headlights and windows. His cape hangs behind a steady stance. The coloring sheet combines broad vehicle panels with wheel circles, a streetlamp, and distant buildings.

pages.title: Superman Stopping a Speeding Locomotive Before It Reaches a Broken Railway Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman stops a locomotive before a broken railway bridge in this printable coloring page, pressing both palms against the round boiler above splintered supports and falling debris. His cape streams behind his braced stance. Spoked wheels, rail fasteners, and timber grain create numerous small sections across the detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Catching a Falling Helicopter Above a City Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman catching a falling helicopter above a city rooftop, gripping its landing skids while the rotor spins over the rounded cabin. His cape curves beside his bent legs. A water tower, antenna, and simple building outlines add smaller rooftop details beneath the helicopter's broad panels.

pages.title: Superman Carrying a Child Out of a Burning Apartment Building Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman carries a child out of a burning apartment building in this printable coloring page, stepping down from a smoke-filled doorway as the child holds his shoulder. Flames rise beside a railing behind his cape. Clothing folds, stair edges, and outlined smoke clouds add varied sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Using His Freeze Breath to Extinguish a Warehouse Fire Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman using freeze breath to extinguish a warehouse fire, blowing curling streams of air, snowflakes, and ice shapes toward the burning roof. His cheeks puff above the S shield as he hovers nearby. The coloring sheet contrasts sweeping breath patterns with flames and simple warehouse panels.

pages.title: Superman Using Heat Vision to Split an Incoming Meteor Above Earth Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman uses heat vision to split a meteor above Earth in this printable coloring page, directing two straight beams toward a cracked rock surrounded by flying fragments. Stars frame his hovering figure above the curved planet. Broad costume areas contrast with jagged impact marks and outlined continents on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Breaking Steel Chains Wrapped Around His Chest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman breaking chains wrapped around his chest, clenching both fists as snapped links and small fragments scatter beside his S shield. His cape spreads behind the close view of his torso. Large costume sections and narrow interlocking chain outlines give the coloring sheet contrasting shapes.

pages.title: Superman Rescuing an Astronaut Beside a Damaged Space Capsule Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman rescues an astronaut beside a damaged space capsule in this printable coloring page, holding the suited figure near a cratered surface beneath scattered stars. The capsule has a cracked exterior and an open side hatch. Helmet fittings, suit panels, and small rocks add detail around the broad figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Flying in Outer Space Above the Curved Horizon of Earth Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman flying through outer space above Earth's curved horizon, extending one fist as his cape trails among stars and small ringed planets. A crescent moon sits above his shoulder. Broad sky and costume sections surround the finer continent outlines and swirling clouds on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Supporting a Passenger Airplane as It Approaches an Airport Runway Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman supports a passenger airplane near an airport runway in this printable coloring page, holding the fuselage overhead beneath its engines, windows, and lowered landing wheels. His cape flows above the runway markings. The coloring sheet includes broad wings, a small control tower, and narrow rows of passenger windows.

pages.title: Superman Listening to a Holographic Message from Jor El Inside the Fortress of Solitude Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman listening to a holographic message from Jor El inside the Fortress of Solitude, standing beside a faceted projector among tall crystals. Jor El gestures within the outlined projection above the device. Angular crystal faces contrast with cape folds and the smaller hologram details.

pages.title: Superman Battling Lex Luthor in His Armored Power Suit Outside Lexcorp Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman battles Lex Luthor outside Lexcorp in this printable coloring page, flying toward the armored villain as Lex raises two large mechanical fists before the building's windows. A circular chest panel marks the power suit. Armor joints, segmented fingers, and cape folds provide varied details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Blocking a Powerful Punch From Doomsday on a Damaged City Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman blocking Doomsday's punch on a damaged city street, bracing his arm against the villain's huge spiked forearm beside an impact burst. Doomsday towers above cracked pavement and rubble. The coloring sheet pairs Superman's broad costume sections with jagged bone spikes and broken masonry.

pages.title: Superman Facing Metallo as the Robot Reveals the Kryptonite Core in His Chest Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman faces Metallo in this printable coloring page as the robot opens his chest to reveal a faceted kryptonite core surrounded by sharp radiating marks. Superman draws one arm across his body beside the exposed panel. Mechanical joints, rivets, and large armor plates add detailed shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Superman Confronting Bizarro on a Deserted Metropolis Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Superman confronting Bizarro on a deserted Metropolis street, with Bizarro's reversed chest emblem and ragged costume facing Superman's smooth suit and cape. Empty buildings line the road behind their clenched fists. The coloring sheet includes broad costume areas, jagged cuffs, and simple window sections.

pages.title: Superman Battling General Zod High Above the Metropolis Skyline Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman battles General Zod above Metropolis in this printable coloring page, extending a fist toward the armored opponent while both capes sweep above the city skyline. Zod raises an arm beside the impact marks between them. The Daily Planet globe, armor panels, and broad cape folds add detail to the coloring sheet.
